headline: This law makes public safety officers who died from World Trade Center-related health conditions after helping with the 9/11 response eligible for the 9/11 Heroes Medal of Valor.
what_it_does: The law changes who can receive the 9/11 Heroes Medal of Valor. It adds public safety officers who took part in the response to the September 11, 2001 terrorist attacks and who died because of a World Trade Center-related health condition caused by that participation. The summary does not describe any payment or service attached to the medal.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on November 3, 2018.
